const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/install-w29-publication.sh
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+set -euo pipefail
+
+repo=/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation
+cd "$repo"
+
+manifest=.ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/PACK-MANIFEST.json
+snapshot=evidence/quality/repair-window-29-20260925/orchestration
+window=evidence/quality/repair-window-29-20260925
+
+while IFS=$'\t' read -r source relative_destination expected_sha expected_bytes; do
+  actual_sha=$(sha256sum -- "$source" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+  actual_bytes=$(stat -c %s -- "$source")
+  if [[ "$actual_sha" != "$expected_sha" || "$actual_bytes" != "$expected_bytes" ]]; then
+    echo "source mismatch: $source" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+  destination="$snapshot/$relative_destination"
+  if [[ -e "$destination" ]]; then
+    destination_sha=$(sha256sum -- "$destination" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+    destination_bytes=$(stat -c %s -- "$destination")
+    if [[ "$destination_sha" != "$expected_sha" || "$destination_bytes" != "$expected_bytes" ]]; then
+      echo "existing destination mismatch: $destination" >&2
+      exit 1
+    fi
+  else
+    mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$destination")"
+    cp -- "$source" "$destination"
+  fi
+  installed_sha=$(sha256sum -- "$destination" | cut -d' ' -f1)
+  installed_bytes=$(stat -c %s -- "$destination")
+  if [[ "$installed_sha" != "$expected_sha" || "$installed_bytes" != "$expected_bytes" ]]; then
+    echo "installed destination mismatch: $destination" >&2
+    exit 1
+  fi
+done < <(jq -r '.files[] | [.source, .relative_destination, .sha256, (.bytes|tostring)] | @tsv' "$manifest")
+
+manifest_destination="$window/orchestration-pack-manifest.json"
+if [[ -e "$manifest_destination" ]] && ! cmp -s -- "$manifest" "$manifest_destination"; then
+  echo "existing manifest snapshot mismatch: $manifest_destination" >&2
+  exit 1
+fi
+cp -- "$manifest" "$manifest_destination"
+
+candidate=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-candidate-catalog
+while IFS= read -r source; do
+  destination=${source#"$candidate/"}
+  mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$destination")"
+  cp -- "$source" "$destination"
+done < <(find "$candidate" -type f -print | sort)
+
+migration_source=.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-migration.json
+migration_destination=evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/33667e0f131e372a7f313763a9e2bbac876a263a88eb1784c9c063a2f50da619.json
+mkdir -p -- "$(dirname -- "$migration_destination")"
+cp -- "$migration_source" "$migration_destination"
+
+publication="$window/publication"
+mkdir -p -- "$publication"
+for name in PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json; do
+  cp -- ".ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/$name" "$publication/$name"
+done
+for source in .ai/task/repair-w29-20260925/ADJUDICATION-*.json; do
+  cp -- "$source" "$publication/$(basename -- "$source")"
+done
+for source in \
+  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-publish-chain.log \
+  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-publish-chain-timing.json \
+  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-migration.json \
+  .artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window29-20260925-migration-timing.json
+do
+  name=$(basename -- "$source")
+  name=${name#window29-20260925-}
+  cp -- "$source" "$publication/$name"
+done

+echo "installed manifest files: $(jq '.files | length' "$manifest")"
+echo "candidate files copied: $(find "$candidate" -type f | wc -l)"
+echo "publication attachments: $(find "$publication" -maxdepth 1 -type f | wc -l)"
*** End Patch";
